summary_bullets: Align Codex Step 0 probe with production model args so quota failures surface before review
Suppress false empty-reviewer-rows WARN when output carries the no_issues_found sentinel
Add offline harness cases for probe model forwarding and sentinel zero-findings slots
commit_message:
Fix misleading /design review panel Codex probe and empty-rows WARN (#3402)

Pass agent-model-args.sh --tool codex --with-effort into the Codex availability probe so model-specific quota failures mark CODEX_PRESENT=false at Step 0 instead of mid-run. Suppress plan-review-tsv empty-rows warnings when reviewer output contains the canonical {"no_issues_found": true} sentinel.
